floor_grass.notes: walkable ground: turf with blades, clover, flowers on an earth slab

floor_path.notes: walkable ground: packed dirt with ruts and pebbles

floor_pave.notes: walkable ground (town): four bevelled slabs, grout, moss and a crack

water.notes: blocking unless surfing; surface at -0.05 m, foam edges, ripple rings, lily pads

tree.notes: blocking, ~2.3 m: root flare, layered faceted canopy

wall.notes: blocking 1 m: staggered ashlar courses, plinth, coping, moss

building_wall.notes: blocking 1.2 m: brick plinth, plaster, timber posts, window and eave trim

roof.notes: gable roof piece, ridge along X, 0.6 m: shingle rows, ridge cap, rake boards; stack on building_wall

door.notes: warp tile: framed plank door, hinges, handle, step, lintel and canopy on the -Y face

counter.notes: blocking, waist height: panelled cabinet, overhanging top, gold trim

ledge.notes: one-way jump-down: earth strata, grassy overhang, edge stones; lip on -Y

rock.notes: blocking boulder: facets, chips, moss, crack

window.notes: wall segment with framed window, sill, flower box and shutters

pillar.notes: stone pillar with base and capital
